title: ScorecardAssociation - Data API
description: Represents a connection between a specific scorecard and the associated account, channel program, or channel program level. This object is available in API version 41.0 and later.

LastReferencedDate.description: The timestamp when the current user last accessed this record, a record related to this record, or a list view.

LastViewedDate.description: The timestamp when the current user last viewed this record or list view. If this value is null, the user might have only accessed this record or list view (LastReferencedDate) but not viewed it.

Name.properties: Autonumber, Defaulted on create, Filter, idLookup, Sort
Name.description: The name of the Scorecard Association.

ScorecardId.description: The ID of the scorecard that the association is related to. Several metrics can be tied to a single scorecard. This is a relationship field.

TargetEntityId.description: The associated object that a specific scorecard is associated with. This is a polymorphic relationship field.
